scenario: Validate a runner request from an authorized tenant CICD admin
preconditions: Tenant in registry; requester is active member of <tenant>-admin team
form_inputs: org, tenant, runner_name, image, source=github, size, approver, dry_run=true
expected_result: Status awaiting_approval; tenant resolved; runner name derived as TenantName_runner; no mutation

preconditions: CR-01 issue open; comment by the designated approver
expected_result: Status approved; dry-run so no runner created; result comment posted

scenario: Reject a requester who is not on the tenant CICD admin team
preconditions: Tenant in registry; requester NOT a member of <tenant>-admin
expected_result: Rejected: requester is not an active member of the tenant CI/CD admin team

preconditions: No registry record for the tenant name
expected_result: Rejected: no authorized tenant CI/CD context for that tenant

scenario: Live create produces a real runner
preconditions: Enterprise PAT secret set; dry_run=false; approved
expected_result: Runner created and visible under org Settings > Actions > Runners; audit artifact records creation
